title: dactylorhiza latifolia var. pinguis
intro: Dactylorhiza latifolia var. pinguis, commonly known as the Broad-leaved Marsh Orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid belonging to the Orchidaceae family. It is primarily found in the marshy and wetland areas of Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa, and is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine. The health benefits of Dactylorhiza latifolia var. pinguis include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which also exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant properties.
